title: YMCA Camp Minikani

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Our variety of Day Camps will ensure your child a summer that parallels your own fond memories playing outside as a kid. Through creative and engaging outdoor activities, your child will explore, play and socialize with their group in a safe environment made for kids. Your child’s counselors were once campers at Minikani, and they will help your camper navigate many fun and sometimes unfamiliar activities. Throughout these experiences, your child will be safe, supported and inspired by their counselor. services.name: Retreats & Rentals
services.desc: YMCA Camp Minikani offers the perfect place to disconnect from everyday life and reconnect with family, friends, colleagues, or peers. Just 25 minutes from downtown Milwaukee, our 150-acres of prairie, woodlands, and trails offer a peaceful escape where you can immerse yourself in nature. With space for groups of up to 250, Camp Minikani provides an ideal setting for bonding, reflection, and growth. Our dedicated staff can guide your group through specialized programs designed to inspire new perspectives and meaningful connections. services.name: School Groups
services.desc: YMCA Camp Minikani’s Enviromental Education Program is a hands-on, experiential learning opportunity designed to envelop students in the natural world. Spanning 150 acres of diverse landscapes, including forests, wetlands, prairies, and a scenic lake, our programing provides an engaging and interactive way for students to explore environmental science, teamwork, and personal growth. Our objectives are simple: Give your students the gift of discovery, where learning comes to life in the great outdoors!
